messages:
nina: Quick sync request 1: we need a minimal SI onboarding pack for Datadog + OTLP validation for Private deployments. Goal: make it a 10-min checklist SI engineers can use to certify observability before go-live. Who can take lead on checklist + sample configs?

ddliaison: I can own the Datadog-side checklist (what keys/scopes, sample dashboard widgets, query examples). We should also include expected ingestion delays and common misconfig checks.

alex: Obs team volunteer here. I'll draft an OTLP collector snippet, a log/trace redaction checklist, and a simple dashboard JSON that SIs can import. Prefer we keep the sample configs small so they can paste into a container test.

jordan: Security note 1: SIs will often run certs + cross-account networking. Add explicit steps for: 1) validating TLS to the collector, 2) verifying no customer PII in exported samples, and 3) a contact for emergency data-removal requests. I can write the PII checklist.

carmen: From SI perspective: we need a short troubleshooting flow 1 (3 bullets) for when traces/metrics don't appear. Also would be great to have a "fast smoke" command they can run in their environment that sends a sanitized sample event.

alex: Agreed. Draft smoke CLI (single curl) we can include:
```
# smoke-send.sh (sanitized)
echo '{"service":"rw-sanity","type":"smoke","msg":"ok"}' | \
curl -s -X POST ${OTLP_ENDPOINT} -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${OTLP_TOKEN}" --data @-
```
Make sure the script strips any free-text fields before sending.

jordan: Redaction rules (short): remove headers/params named: Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, user_email, user_id, session_token. Truncate any "prompt_text" or "input" fields to 1024 chars. Add these as mandatory steps in the pack.

ddliaison: Datadog checklist items I'll include: - required API key role for logs/metrics/traces - recommended metric names (rw.si.*) - example metric query for canary: `avg:rw.si.canary.latency{env:staging}` - how to import the dashboard JSON (one-click) - expected tile lag ~20-40s

carmen: The "one-click" idea is important. Can we provide both: a dashboard JSON and a minimal CW/OTLP mapping file so they can import into their collector? Some SIs use Collector v0.50 and others are on v0.60.

alex: I'll provide two OTLP snippets (v0.50 and v0.60 compatible) and a tiny mapping file that renames attributes to `rw_*` prefixes. Example mapping (pseudo):
```
# attributes_pipeline.yaml
processors:
  - attributes:
      actions:
        - key: "feature_flag"
          action: "insert"
          value: "rw_ff_unknown"
        - key: "user_id"
          action: "delete"
```
This keeps PII out and standardizes labels.

carmen: For troubleshooting flow, suggest 3 steps: 1) run smoke-send -> confirm 200, 2) check collector logs for send/recv, 3) query Datadog for `avg:rw.si.canary.latency` and `count:rw.si.smoke{origin:si}`. If any step fails, check firewall and token scope.

jordan: Also add an audit step: run `grep -E "(email|social|ssn|credit)"` on exported sample payloads to catch obvious leaks before sharing examples with Redwood or Datadog.

ddliaison: I'll prepare a short "what we ask from SI" bullet list for the marketplace submission: enable canary endpoint, provide sample dashboard import, confirm redaction script ran, and sign a short telemetry attestation form.

alex: Who wants to own the actual pack file? I can assemble if someone vets the security text and Datadog bits.

nina: @alex assemble. @jordan vet security text. @ddliaison vet Datadog items. @carmen we'll get an SI engineer to test. Timeline: can we have a draft pack by end of week for internal review?

carmen: We can test on Thursday with one SI. I'll book a 30-min slot and ping results.

jordan: I'll carve out time Thursday morning to review redaction + attestation wording.

ddliaison: I have a pre-made dashboard skeleton I can drop in. Will add a short paragraph about expected SLOs for the tile.

deploy-bot: canary deploy success: otlp-collector-config-test @ 3950012360 :white_check_mark:

nina: Great. Next steps I will track: 1) Alex assemble pack + include OTLP v0.50/0.60 snippets and mapping, 2) Jordan finalizes PII checklist & attestation line, 3) DD liaison attaches dashboard JSON + query examples, 4) Carmen runs SI test and reports. Please post updates here. :thumbsup:
